Subject: Private offer for 90d trial -> annual commit (CloudOps)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team liked the latency profile for our inference-heavy pipelines. We want to pilot Redwood in prod for 90 days, then convert to a signed private offer if metrics look good. A few urgent questions procurement asked: 

- Can we structure the pilot as a private offer on AWS Marketplace (so spend counts toward marketplace activation)?
- For the conversion, can credits be prorated against an annual commitment, and what are typical discount bands?
- What does buyer approval look like for larger enterprises (procurement -> finance -> legal)? Any templates to speed approvals?

We have stakeholders in the US and a small EU team — any region-specific caveats we should expect?

Attaching our internal trial scope (SOW) and a short compliance checklist. Happy to hop on a pulse call this week.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Head of Platform, CloudOps Solutions

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private offer for 90d trial -> annual commit (CloudOps)

Hi Emily — great conversation, appreciate the level of detail in the SOW. Confirming the short answers up front and then a recommended path below: 

Short answers:
- Yes: we can create an AWS Marketplace private offer that is used for trial billing (customer redeems an MPO for the pilot). Activation via MPO keeps the purchase on AWS and supports co-sell tracking.
- Proration: when converting to an annual private offer, we typically issue a credit for unused pilot days (pro-rated) and apply it to the first invoice of the annual commitment. We can show two scenario examples in the MPO draft.
- Approvals: typical buyer flow is procurement -> finance -> legal. For enterprise deals we expect 5-8 business days for procurement sign-off if no special terms.

Recommended structure (what we've seen work):
1) MPO for pilot: 90-day MPO with a nominal pilot price (e.g., 50% of listed rate) and activation window tied to a HubSpot deal.
2) Conversion trigger: auto-email placeholder that starts 30 days before pilot end and includes a simple acceptance form + DocuSign link to lock the annual MPO terms.
3) Credit handling: prorate pilot against annual commitment; we document the math in Section 4 of the MPO PDF.
4) Evidence & compliance: provide an evidence pack (SOC summary, data flow diagram) to speed procurement/legal.

Two asks for us to draft the MPO & accelerate approvals:
- Please share the list of named approvers (procurement contact, finance approver, legal reviewer) and their timelines.
- Confirm whether EU spend should be handled under the same MPO or a separate regional MPO (often procurement prefers a single global PO, but AWS billing and tax can complicate this).

I attached a short MPO draft and a conversion example. Rishi — looping you to confirm pricing bands and how we should represent credits on the MPO.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: CloudOps_MPO_Draft.pdf (MPO mockup)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Hi Emily + team — quick note on pricing and activation logistics.

Pricing recommendation (example, adjustable):
- Pilot MPO (90d): 50% of list for pilot usage up to 20k tokens/day; overage billed at list.
- Conversion to annual: tiers based on committed monthly throughput. Typical discount bands: 20% off list for 1yr, 30% for 2yr. We can add a 5% co-sell uplift if you qualify for joint marketing.

Operational notes:
- Deal id: CO-2027-531 (create in HubSpot).
- We will provide an MPO PDF that includes the prorate example and a DocuSign-ready signature block.
- For EU spend: recommend a single MPO with regional billing notes if your procurement insists; otherwise we can do parallel MPOs. Separate MPOs can add 3-5 business days for activation.

Security/evidence: Priyom — can you confirm which artifacts we should include in an evidence bundle for CloudOps? (SOC summary + dataflow + encryption attestation typically.)

Next steps I propose:
- Emily: share named approvers and preferred DocuSign signer.
- CloudOps procurement: share PO template if you have one.
- Redwood: we'll circulate a final MPO draft with proration worked examples by Tuesday.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
